\section[(dialogue)]{Food and nature — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R134-first-pass-food-and-nature}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a beard and a moustache.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item grass, a seed, a root, a bud, an island
  \item a shore, a waterfall, a cave, a valley, a sand hill
  \item a desert, lightning, a storm, the earth, moonlight
  \item darkness, light, shade, a rainbow, a rabbit
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Grass? (\textbf{\pa{ਘਾਹ}}, \emph{ghāh}.) A seed? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੀਜ}}, \emph{bīj}.) A root? (\textbf{\pa{ਜੜ੍ਹ}}, \emph{jaṛh}.) A bud? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਲੀ}}, \emph{kalī}.) An island? (\textbf{\pa{ਟਾਪੂ}}, \emph{ṭāpū}.) A shore? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਿਨਾਰਾ}}, \emph{kinārā}.) A waterfall? (\textbf{\pa{ਝਰਨਾ}}, \emph{jharnā}.) A cave? (\textbf{\pa{ਗੁਫ਼ਾ}}, \emph{gufā}.) A valley? (\textbf{\pa{ਵਾਦੀ}}, \emph{vādī}.) A sand hill? (\textbf{\pa{ਟਿੱਬਾ}}, \emph{ṭibbā}.) A desert? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਾਰੂਥਲ}}, \emph{mārūthal}.) Lightning? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਿਜਲੀ}}, \emph{bijlī}.) A storm? (\textbf{\pa{ਤੂਫ਼ਾਨ}}, \emph{tūfān}.) The earth? (\textbf{\pa{ਧਰਤੀ}}, \emph{dhartī}.) Moonlight? (\textbf{\pa{ਚਾਨਣੀ}}, \emph{cānṇī}.) Darkness? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਨੇਰਾ}}, \emph{hanerā}.) Light? (\textbf{\pa{ਚਾਨਣ}}, \emph{cānaṇ}.) Shade? (\textbf{\pa{ਛਾਂ}}, \emph{chā̃}.) A rainbow? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਤਰੰਗੀ} \pa{ਪੀਂਘ}}, \emph{satrangī pīṅgh}.) A rabbit? (\textbf{\pa{ਖ਼ਰਗੋਸ਼}}, \emph{khargosh}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Nature and animals — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R134-second-pass-nature-and-animals}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a deer and a bear.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a deer, a bear, a jackal, a wolf, a pigeon
  \item a duck, a lizard, a turtle, a crocodile, a mosquito
  \item a fly, a bee, a butterfly, a spider, a squirrel
  \item a rooster, a hen, a donkey, an owl, a crow
  \item a cheek, a forehead, an eyebrow, a beard, a moustache
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A deer? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਿਰਨ}}, \emph{hiran}.) A bear? (\textbf{\pa{ਰਿੱਛ}}, \emph{ricch}.) A jackal? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਿੱਦੜ}}, \emph{giddaṛ}.) A wolf? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਘਿਆੜ}}, \emph{baghiāṛ}.) A pigeon? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਬੂਤਰ}}, \emph{kabūtar}.) A duck? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੱਤਖ਼}}, \emph{battakh}.) A lizard? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਿਰਲੀ}}, \emph{kirlī}.) A turtle? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੱਛੂ}}, \emph{kacchū}.) A crocodile? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਗਰਮੱਛ}}, \emph{magarmacch}.) A mosquito? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੱਛਰ}}, \emph{macchar}.) A fly? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੱਖੀ}}, \emph{makkhī}.) A bee? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਧੂਮੱਖੀ}}, \emph{madhūmakkhī}.) A butterfly? (\textbf{\pa{ਤਿਤਲੀ}}, \emph{titlī}.) A spider? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੱਕੜੀ}}, \emph{makkaṛī}.) A squirrel? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਾਲ੍ਹੜ}}, \emph{gālhaṛ}.) A rooster? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੁੱਕੜ}}, \emph{kukkaṛ}.) A hen? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੁਰਗੀ}}, \emph{murgī}.) A donkey? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਧਾ}}, \emph{gadhā}.) An owl? (\textbf{\pa{ਉੱਲੂ}}, \emph{ullū}.) A crow? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਾਂ}}, \emph{kā̃}.) A cheek? (\textbf{\pa{ਗੱਲ੍ਹ}}, \emph{gallh}.) A forehead? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੱਥਾ}}, \emph{matthā}.) An eyebrow? (\textbf{\pa{ਭਰਵੱਟਾ}}, \emph{bharavaṭṭā}.) A beard? (\textbf{\pa{ਦਾੜ੍ਹੀ}}, \emph{dāṛhī}.) A moustache? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੁੱਛ}}, \emph{mucch}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
